Submission Instructions

  1. Populate docs/edition.xml with <front><div type="introduction">, full <editorialDecl>, <licence> (CC BY 4.0) + matching <respStmt> IDs, and <back><listBibl>; confirm 0 errors in VS Code's XML Problems panel and QA (0) in the viewer.
  2. Export docs/edition_print.pdf via Chrome Print / PDF (showing front preface, dual reading columns, notes, and bibliography) and verify standalone offline edition_viewer.html in browser.
  3. Log your 5-point structured peer review audit in PEER_REVIEW.md and full tool/LLM accountability in AI_PROVENANCE.md (and README.md with licensing details).
  4. After freezing final edits, run sha256sum to generate CHECKSUMS.txt (verified clean with sha256sum -c) and publish annotated tag v1.0.0 as a GitHub Release with PDF & offline HTML attached.
  5. Submit your live GitHub Pages URL, tagged v1.0.0 Release link (or repository ZIP), and portfolio checklist in Moodle.
